notes.title: About the game development direction(2022/6/14)
notes.content:
Wow, this game is already two years old. During this period, the project has experienced various problems that make development hit the wall. Many players probably thought that the game was dead from then on. I'm really sorry for that.

But now that the problem is overcome, we can finally continue to focus on the development of this game, but for players who played this game before or players who put us on the wishlist, the next revision may drastically change the gameplay. If you have doubts, you can postpone the purchase or get a refund if possible, but you can also look forward to the new Church Era content after the rebirth.

1. This game will no longer be based on board game-style gameplay, nor is it a game of choosing a faction, but an RPG-like adventure from the perspective of characters.
2. It is no longer a turn-based game, there will be a concept of time flow, the game duration is equal to the life of your character, and whether there is an inheritance mechanism has not yet been decided.
3. Emphasize a high degree of freedom. Your characters can freely choose who they want to work with, socialize with, get married, etc. Some fictional historical events will occur in the game (if the conditions are met), and the results of it will be recorded and placed on the character's biography page.
4. The map is no longer limited to a low-resolution single image, but a huge map that can be dragged, and the number of towns is no longer limited.
5. The siege battle will retain the style of the old version as much as possible. It's now the secondary mechanism.
6. There is no such thing as a miracle card anymore, maybe the art will be used to make other functions.
7. The item mechanism has become the one you are probably familiar with, that is, having personal items system.
8. You can develop your own character's skills in fields such as medicine, science, tactics, etc.
9. If possible, an editor will be made to allow players to freely edit in-game objects and even create their own characters, nations, religions, etc.

...there are more to come, in short, it will not be a small revision, and it is very likely to overwrite the previous saves and achievements.

If for some reason you are still following this game, I hope this change will not affect your experience too much.
We will try to bring this revision online before the end of the year, so stay tuned.
